card.name: However and although after a clause
card.fires_on: Contrast words such as "however" and "although" that open a new clause right after a comma, semicolon or full stop. The first part of the sentence states a fact, and the contrast word introduces a qualification.

modes.label: however after semicolon
modes.description: "however" follows a semicolon and introduces a qualifying statement.
modes.example: Fatalities have been reported;<< however>> patients have recovered from valproate levels

modes.label: although after comma
modes.description: "although" follows a comma and adds a concession to the main clause.
modes.example: Application to broken or inflamed skin,<< although>> not tested, may result in higher blood

modes.description: "However" starts a sentence after a stated finding.
